message.reasoning: The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service Docker" in PowerShell. Or use "docker-machine start default" if using Docker Toolbox. But likely they want to start Docker Desktop. The user might want to run a command to start Docker. We can provide a command: "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service Docker".
